summary: Iter 41 — Alert scheduling (CRUD + Eastern tz + past/missing-title 400 + 404-after-delete + non-admin 403), _send_scheduled in-process (status flips scheduled→sent, push_log kind=custom created, idempotent on second call), tap tracking (unique per user via push_taps unique index, unknown log_id no-op, history returns tapped count), this-week (sections present, seeded meeting+announcement surfaced), weekly summary (GET/PUT paused + preview line, POST send → push_log kind=weekly url /members?tab=week, _push_weekly fires once Sunday ≥18:00 ET and 0 on non-Sunday/before-18/paused), profile.push_weekly persists. Frontend: admin Phone-alert form (later checkbox reveals datetime, 'Schedule alert' → row in scheduled-alerts, edit shows admin-push-editing + 'Save changes', cancel removes row), weekly-summary-admin complete (status/preview/toggle/send), push-history-tapped-* rows render 'N tapped of M reached', push-history-filter-weekly present. Portal: 12-tab grid, grid-cols-3 on mobile 390 = 4 rows of 3, no horizontal overflow; /members?tab=week renders this-week with week-events, week-votes, week-birthdays, week-news; profile-push-weekly checkbox visible. 11/11 backend pytest green; all frontend assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: _clean_scheduled parses send_at as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' with EVENT_TZ (America/New_York) and persists both UTC send_at (ISO) + send_at_local (original) — correct for displaying 'Eastern' later.
Past-time rule rejects send_at ≤ now + 1 min (so a tightly timed future value just over 60s works). Explicit 'future' message.
GET /admin/members/push/scheduled filters status=scheduled only (cancelled/sent are hidden). PUT/DELETE match on {status:'scheduled'} so already-sent/cancelled correctly 404.
_send_scheduled uses find_one_and_update → {status:'sending'} atomically before dispatching, then flips to 'sent'. This prevents double-fire across concurrent push loops.
push/tapped relies on unique index (log_id, user_id); DuplicateKeyError silently swallowed → true per-user uniqueness. Unknown log_id early-returns {ok:true} without insert.
_push_users embeds log_id in the push payload JSON — sw.js can POST tapped on notificationclick. ✓

_push_weekly guards: weekday()==6 (Sunday ZoneInfo-aware), hour>=18, paused flag in settings{key:'weekly_summary'}, _push_mark 'weekly:{date}' insert into unique index for idempotency. Correct precedence.
weekly summary 'send now' is rate-limited admin-weekly:<uid> 3/600s — tight but acceptable; test now skips (not fails) on 429 for stable reruns.
ThisWeek front-end sections: week-events (gatherings+sessions), week-votes, week-birthdays, week-news, optional week-more for spotlights+minutes. Mobile grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-2 — good.
Members tabbar uses grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 md:flex md:flex-wrap — on 390px that's 12 items × 4 rows × 3 cols, no overflow (measured sw=cw=348).
profile-push-weekly checkbox uses MemberProfile Pydantic model field push_weekly:bool default True; verified persistence via users.member_profile.push_weekly.

Minor nit: load() in AdminPush is called on every reset(); fine. Scheduled row 'when' uses new Date(send_at_local) which is interpreted as LOCAL browser tz, not Eastern — may show mismatched time for users not in ET (display-only; label says 'Eastern'). Non-blocking cosmetic.
test_credentials: QA admin cookie session_token=qa_tok_123 and member cookies mem_tok_a/mem_tok_b — all torn down at end (qa_session.py down + qa_members.py down).
seed_data_creation: Transient rows in push_scheduled, push_log, push_taps, push_marks, member_meetings, member_announcements, settings{key:'weekly_summary'} created during tests and cleaned in teardown_module + final db sweep (confirmed 0 QA- rows remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pattern for in-process async tests with motor: use helper _run(coros) which creates a new event loop AND rebinds server.client/db via AsyncIOMotorClient(..., io_loop=loop) at the top of each _run call — motor is lazily bound to its creation loop so cross-test loops fail with 'Event loop is closed'. Group multiple server coroutines inside one _run (use asyncio.to_thread for sync DB side-effects between awaits). Weekly-summary send-now rate limit is 3/600s per admin — test gracefully skips on 429. Only one carryover from iter_40: scheduled-row 'when' label displays using browser local tz (not Eastern) — cosmetic only.
